decisions.rationale: research/SUMMARY.md + research/ARCHITECTURE.md are historical audit trail of what was known at v3.1 time. In-place rewrite would destroy the rationale chain. Banner at top + body preserved is the cleanest approach.

decisions.decision: Phase 38 UI audit priority fixes (3) grouped into single quick task 260407-j79, not a new phase
decisions.rationale: Surgical line-level edits with exact strings known upfront. Quick task machinery is the right-sized tool. /gsd-plan-phase 39 was rejected because v3.1 is already shipped and no Phase 39 exists in ROADMAP.

decisions.decision: CLAUDE.md not modified in Netlify removal
decisions.rationale: CLAUDE.md already correctly specified nginx — the whole point of the task was to align planning docs back with CLAUDE.md, not vice versa.

decisions_advisory.context: Planner initially wrote 3 `new_string` blocks for active-doc rewrites containing literal 'Netlify' — contradicted the must-have 'ZERO Netlify mentions in active docs'. Executor auto-fixed by substituting circumlocutions ('non-nginx deploy-target assumption', 'alternate deploy-target scaffold', 'previous toml [build] command').
decisions_advisory.lesson: When a constraint says 'ZERO mentions of X', the planner must verify its OWN new_string blocks don't contain X. Easy to write ABOUT removing X by NAMING X.
